title: Receptionists and Information Clerks
description: Answer inquiries and provide information to the general public, customers, visitors, and other interested parties regarding activities conducted at establishment and location of departments, offices, and employees within the organization.

tasks.text: Operate telephone switchboard to answer, screen, or forward calls, providing information, taking messages, or scheduling appointments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Calendar scheduling automatable; exceptions need human judgment

dwas.name: Answer telephones to direct calls or provide information.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Greet persons entering establishment, determine nature and purpose of visit, and direct or escort them to specific destinations.
Receive payment and record receipts for services.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Handling cash/payment collection in person

tasks.text: Schedule appointments and maintain and update appointment calendars.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Calendar scheduling automatable; exceptions need human judgment

tasks.text: Transmit information or documents to customers, using computer, mail, or facsimile machine.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Sending digital materials automatable; physical mailing human

tasks.text: Hear and resolve complaints from customers or the public.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Drafting responses easy; live de-escalation is human

dwas.name: Respond to customer problems or complaints.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Filing physical documents requires hands in the world

tasks.text: Provide information about establishment, such as location of departments or offices, employees within the organization, or services provided.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Customer dialogue needs live presence and adaptation

dwas.name: Discuss goods or services information with customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Perform administrative support tasks, such as proofreading, transcribing handwritten information, or operating calculators or computers to work with pay records, invoices, balance sheets, or other documents.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Proofreading text for accuracy is core LLM strength

dwas.name: Proofread documents, records, or other files to ensure accuracy.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Collect, sort, distribute, or prepare mail, messages, or courier deliveries.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sorting and delivering physical mail

tasks.text: Perform duties, such as taking care of plants or straightening magazines to maintain lobby or reception area.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of facilities and equipment

tasks.text: Analyze data to determine answers to questions from customers or members of the public.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Operational/research data analysis; human interprets

tasks.text: Calculate and quote rates for tours, stocks, insurance policies, or other products or services.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cost calculation from structured inputs

dwas.name: Calculate costs of goods or services.

tasks.text: Keep a current record of staff members' whereabouts and availability.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record personnel information into databases

tasks.text: Schedule space or equipment for special programs and prepare lists of participants.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Algorithmic scheduling with human oversight of constraints

tasks.text: Process and prepare memos, correspondence, travel vouchers, or other documents.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Routine business correspondence fully draftable by AI

tasks.text: Enroll individuals to participate in programs and notify them of their acceptance.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Routine customer notifications largely automatable

dwas.name: Provide notifications to customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Take orders for merchandise or materials and send them to the proper departments to be filled.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Sending digital materials automatable; physical mailing human

emerging_tasks.task: Enter and update databases of contact information, such as names, addresses, and phone numbers.
